sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽一起整理书包。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì yīqǐ zhěnglǐ shūbāo.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili packed their schoolbags together.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng bǎ shū fàngjìn shūbāo lǐ.
sentences.english: Xiaoming put the books into his schoolbag.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽把铅笔放进铅笔盒里。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì bǎ qiānbǐ fàngjìn qiānbǐhé lǐ.
sentences.english: Lili put the pencil into the pencil case.

sentences.hanzi: 小明发现他的铅笔盒不见了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng fāxiàn tā de qiānbǐhé bù jiàn le.
sentences.english: Xiaoming discovered that his pencil case was missing.

sentences.hanzi: 他问丽丽：“你看见我的铅笔盒了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Tā wèn Lìlì: "Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de qiānbǐhé le ma?"
sentences.english: He asked Lili, "Did you see my pencil case?"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我没有看见。你的铅笔盒是什么颜色的？”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ méiyǒu kànjiàn. Nǐ de qiānbǐhé shì shénme yánsè de?"
sentences.english: Lili said, "I didn't see it. What color is your pencil case?"

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“我的铅笔盒是蓝色的，上面有一只小狗。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ de qiānbǐhé shì lánsè de, shàngmiàn yǒu yī zhī xiǎogǒu."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "My pencil case is blue, and there is a little dog on it."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我们一起找一找吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒmen yīqǐ zhǎo yī zhǎo ba."
sentences.english: Lili said, "Let's look for it together."

sentences.hanzi: 他们先看了看桌子上，又看了看椅子上，都没有找到。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiān kàn le kàn zhuōzi shàng, yòu kàn le kàn yǐzi shàng, dōu méiyǒu zhǎodào.
sentences.english: They first looked on the table and then on the chair, but they didn't find it.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“别着急，我们再找一找。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Bié zháojí, wǒmen zài zhǎo yī zhǎo."
sentences.english: Lili said, "Don't worry, let's look again."
They walked over to the side of the sofa.

sentences.hanzi: 小明看了看沙发下面，看见一个蓝色的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng kàn le kàn shāfā xiàmiàn, kànjiàn yī gè lánsè de dōngxi.
sentences.english: Xiaoming looked under the sofa and saw a blue thing.

sentences.hanzi: 他高兴地说：“找到了！铅笔盒在沙发下面。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā gāoxìng de shuō: "Zhǎodào le! Qiānbǐhé zài shāfā xiàmiàn."
sentences.english: He said happily, "Found it! The pencil case is under the sofa."

sentences.hanzi: 小明把铅笔盒放进书包里。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng bǎ qiānbǐhé fàngjìn shūbāo lǐ.
sentences.english: Xiaoming put the pencil case into his schoolbag.

sentences.hanzi: 他们拿起书包，开开心心地去上学了。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen náqǐ shūbāo, kāikāixīnxīn de qù shàngxué le.
sentences.english: They picked up their schoolbags and happily went to school.
